22100.construction:
ku + √kar + ta + ya + ka
kukkucca + ka

examples.text: ye te bhikkhū app'icchā santuṭṭhā lajjino kukkuccakā sikkhākāmā te ujjhāyanti khiyyanti vipācenti, kathañ'hi nāma āyasmā dhaniyo kumbhakāraputto rañño dārūni adinnaṃ ādiyissatī'ti!

22101.meaning1: who has stilled restlessness; who has settled agitation

examples.text: aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.

22102.commentary: (VIN 2.5.8.7) kukkuccaṃ upadaheyyā'ti ūnavīsativasso maññe tvaṃ upasampanno, vikāle maññe tayā bhuttaṃ, majjaṃ maññe tayā pītaṃ, mātugāmena saddhiṃ raho maññe tayā nisinnan'ti

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sañcicca kukkuccaṃ upadaheyya iti'ssa muhuttam'pi aphāsu bhavissatī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
dvinnaṃ, bhikkhave, āsavā vaḍḍhanti. katamesaṃ dvinnaṃ? yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṃ kukkuccāyati, yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṃ na kukkuccāyati. imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ āsavā vaḍḍhantī'ti.
pubbe mayaṃ, āvuso, sūpam'pi odanam'pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjāma, tena no phāsu hoti. idāni pana, bhagavatā paṭikkhittan'ti kukkuccāyantā na viññāpema, tena no na phāsu hotī'ti.

22106.meaning1: which should be anxious about; which should be uneasy about; which should be worried about
22106.commentary: (ANa) na kukkuccāyitabban'ti saṅghabhogassa apaṭṭhapanaṃ avicāraṇaṃ na kukkuccāyitabbaṃ nāma, taṃ kukkuccāyati.

examples.text: dvinnaṃ, bhikkhave, āsavā vaḍḍhanti. katamesaṃ dvinnaṃ? yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṃ kukkuccāyati, yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṃ na kukkuccāyati. imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ āsavā vaḍḍhantī'ti.

22107.construction:
ku + √kar + ta + ya + iya
kukkucca + iya

examples.text: okkhittacakkhu na ca pādalolo, jhān'ānuyutto bahujāgarassa, upekkham'ārabbha samāhit'atto, takk'āsayaṃ kukkucciya-upachinde.
aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti hatthi-gav'āssa-vaḷavā-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti

ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha mātā'ti vā mātucchā'ti vā mātulānī'ti vā ācariyabhariyā'ti vā garūnaṃ dārā'ti vā. sambhedaṃ loko agamissa, yathā aj'eḷakā kukkuṭasūkarā soṇasiṅgālā.

22111.meaning1: wild cock; red junglefowl; Gallus gallus

examples.text: jīvañ'jīvaka-sadd'ettha, atho oṭṭhavacittakā, kukkuṭakā kuḷīrakā, vane pokkharasātakā.
ayam'assa paṭham'ābhinibbhidā hoti kukkuṭacchāpakass'eva aṇḍakosamhā.
sā harit'antaṃ vā panth'antaṃ vā sel'antaṃ vā udak'antaṃ vā ramaṇīyaṃ vā bhūmibhāgaṃ āgamma anāhārā nibbāyati. hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ kukkuṭapattena'pi nhārudaddulena'pi aggiṃ gavesanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kukkuṭapattaṃ vā nhārudaddulaṃ vā aggimhi pakkhittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati.
kiñ'c'āpi tassā kukkuṭiyā evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho, vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyun'ti

dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, mahiṃsānaṃ sataṃ mahiṃsabhūtānaṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ … dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, urabbhānaṃ sataṃ urabbhabhūtānaṃ … ajānaṃ sataṃ ajabhūtānaṃ… migānaṃ sataṃ migabhūtānaṃ… kukkuṭānaṃ sataṃ kukkuṭabhūtānaṃ… sūkarānaṃ sataṃ sūkarabhūtānaṃ…

seyyath'idaṃ… hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ nibbuddhaṃ uyyodhikaṃ bal'aggaṃ senābyūhaṃ anīkadassanaṃ iti vā iti evarūpā visūkadassanā paṭivirato samaṇo gotamo'ti

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… hatthilakkhaṇaṃ assalakkhaṇaṃ mahiṃsalakkhaṇaṃ usabhalakkhaṇaṃ golakkhaṇaṃ ajalakkhaṇaṃ meṇḍalakkhaṇaṃ kukkuṭalakkhaṇaṃ vaṭṭakalakkhaṇaṃ

22122.meaning1: nearby; close by; a stone's throw away
22122.commentary: (VINa) kukkuṭasampāde'ti ettha yasmā gāmā nikkhamitvā kukkuṭo padasā'va aññaṃ gāmaṃ gacchati, ayaṃ kukkuṭasampādo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: antamaso gām'antaram'pī'ti kukkuṭasampāte gāme, gām'antare gām'antare āpatti pācittiyassa. agāmake araññe, addhayojane addhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.

22123.meaning1: nearby; close by; a stone's throw away
22123.meaning2: nearby; close by; a stone's throw away
22123.commentary: (DNa) kukkuṭasampātikā'ti ekagāmassa chadanapiṭṭhato uppatitvā itaragāmassa chadanapiṭṭhe patanasaṅkhāto kukkuṭasampāto. etāsu atthī'ti kukkuṭasampātikā. kukkuṭasampādikā'ti'pi pāṭho, gām'antarato gām'antaraṃ kukkuṭānaṃ padasā gamanasaṅkhāto kukkuṭasampādo etāsu atthī'ti attho. ubhayam'p'etaṃ ghananivāsataṃ'y'eva dīpeti.

examples.text: asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ayaṃ jambudīpo iddho c'eva bhavissati phīto ca, kukkuṭasampātikā gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo.

22124.meaning2: no further (from another village) than a cock can walk

22125.meaning1: nearby; close by; a stone's throw away
22125.meaningLit: with the flight of a chicken
22125.commentary: (ANa) kukkuṭasaṃpātikā'ti ekagāmassa chadanapiṭṭhito uppatitvā itaragāmassa chadanapiṭṭhe patanasaṅkhāto kukkuṭasaṃpāto etāsu atthī'ti kukkuṭasaṃpātikā. kukkuṭasaṃpādikā'ti'pi pāṭho, gām'antarato gām'antaraṃ kukkuṭānaṃ padasā gamanasaṅkhāto kukkuṭasaṃpādo etāsu atthī'ti attho. ubhayam'p'etaṃ ghananivāsataṃ'y'eva dīpeti.

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bho gotama, pubbakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, pubbassu'daṃ ayaṃ loko avīci maññe phuṭo ahosi manussehi, kukkuṭasaṃpātikā gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo'ti.
kiñ'ca, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ vadetha? puttabhariyaṃ, bhikkhave, jātidhammaṃ, dāsidāsaṃ jātidhammaṃ, aj'eḷakaṃ jātidhammaṃ, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ jātidhammaṃ
aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, hatthi-gav'assa-vaḷava-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.

tasmiṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yaññe n'eva gāvo haññiṃsu, na aj'eḷakā haññiṃsu, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññiṃsu, na vividhā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjiṃsu, na rukkhā chijjiṃsu yūp'atthāya, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu barihis'atthāya
aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti

22130.meaning1: name of a monastery near Pāṭaliputta; (comm) monastery built by Kukkuṭa

examples.text: atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro yena kukkuṭ'ārāmo yena aññataro bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
seyyathā'pi brāhmaṇa kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
kiñ'c'āpi tassā kukkuṭiyā evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho, vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyun'ti
kukkuṭo nāma, bhante, upāsako nātike kālaṅ'kato, tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo?

22133.synonym: sa, sārameyya, suṇa, sunakha, suvāna, soṇa

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso caṇḍaṃ hatthiṃ parivajjeti, caṇḍaṃ assaṃ parivajjeti, caṇḍaṃ goṇaṃ parivajjeti, caṇḍaṃ kukkuraṃ parivajjeti

ahiṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. suṃsumāraṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. pakkhiṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. kukkuraṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. siṅgālaṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya. makkaṭaṃ gahetvā daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.

22134.meaning1: corpse of a dog; dead dog's body

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto ahikuṇapena vā kukkurakuṇapena vā manussakuṇapena vā kaṇṭhe āsattena aṭṭīyeyya harāyeyya jiguccheyya

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā parisuddhā pariyodātā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā ahikuṇapaṃ vā kukkurakuṇapaṃ vā manussakuṇapaṃ vā racayitvā aññissā kaṃsapātiyā paṭikujjitvā antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ.

22135.meaning1: mind of a dog; dog's mentality
22135.commentary: (MNa) kukkuracittan'ti ajja paṭṭhāya kukkurehi kātabbaṃ karissāmī'ti evaṃ uppannacittaṃ.

examples.text: idha, puṇṇa, ekacco kukkuravataṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkurasīlaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkuracittaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkur'ākappaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ.

tena kho pana samayena sambahulā licchavikumārakā sajjāni dhanūni ādāya kukkurasaṅghaparivutā mahāvane anucaṅkamamānā anuvicaramānā addasu bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ, disvāna sajjāni dhanūni nikkhipitvā kukkurasaṅghaṃ ekam'antaṃ uyyojetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu

22138.meaning1: surrounded by a pack of dogs

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā licchavikumārakā sajjāni dhanūni ādāya kukkurasaṅghaparivutā mahāvane anucaṅkamamānā anuvicaramānā addasu bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ, disvāna sajjāni dhanūni nikkhipitvā kukkurasaṅghaṃ ekam'antaṃ uyyojetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu

22139.meaning1: conduct of a dog; dog's behaviour

examples.text: idha, puṇṇa, ekacco kukkuravataṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkurasīlaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkuracittaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkur'ākappaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ.

22140.meaning1: ascetic practice of behaving like a dog

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko dukkarakārako chamānikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati. tassa taṃ kukkuravataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ. tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti?

22141.meaning1: performing the ascetic practice of behaving like a dog
22141.commentary: (MNa) kukkuravatiko'ti samādinnakukkuravato, sabbaṃ sunakhakiriyaṃ karoti. ubho'p'ete sahapaṃsukīḷikā sahāyakā.

examples.text: atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

22142.meaningLit: discourse with the dog practice ascetic

22143.meaning2: (one) who lives or behaves like a dog (a practice of certain ascetics)

22144.meaning1: bodily behaviour of a dog; dog's physical manner
22144.commentary: (MNa) kukkur'ākappan'ti kukkurānaṃ gaman'ākāro atthi, tiṭṭhan'ākāro atthi, nisīdan'ākāro atthi, sayan'ākāro atthi, uccārapassāvakaraṇ'ākāro atthi, aññe kukkure disvā dante vivaritvā gamanākāro atthi, ayaṃ kukkur'ākappo nāma, taṃ bhāvetī'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, puṇṇa, ekacco kukkuravataṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkurasīlaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkuracittaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkur'ākappaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ.

22145.commentary: (MNa) kukkulanirayo'ti yojanasatappamāṇo'va anto kūṭ'āgāra-matta-vitaccita-aṅgāra-puṇṇo ādittachārikanirayo, yattha patitapatitā kudrūsakarāsimhi khittaphālavāsisil'ādīni viya heṭṭhimatalam'eva gaṇhanti.

examples.text: tassa kho pana, bhikkhave, gūthanirayassa samanantarā sahitam'eva mahanto kukkulanirayo. so tattha patati.

22147.meaning1: hot ash hell; burning ember hell
22147.commentary: (MNa) kukkulanirayo'ti yojanasatappamāṇo'va anto kūṭ'āgāra-matta-vitaccita-aṅgāra-puṇṇo ādittachārikanirayo, yattha patitapatitā kudrūsakarāsimhi khittaphālavāsisil'ādīni viya heṭṭhimatalam'eva gaṇhanti.

examples.text: tassa kho pana, bhikkhave, gūthanirayassa samanantarā sahitam'eva mahanto kukkulanirayo. so tattha patati.

22149.meaning1: like hot ashes; like burning chaff
22149.commentary: (SNa) kukkuḷan'ti santattaṃ ādittaṃ chārikarāsiṃ viya mahāpariḷāhaṃ. imasmiṃ sutte dukkhalakkhaṇaṃ kathitaṃ, sesesu aniccalakkhaṇ'ādīni. sabbāni cetāni pāṭiyekkaṃ puggalajjhāsayena kathitānī'ti.

examples.text: sāvatthinidānaṃ. rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, kukkuḷaṃ, vedanā kukkuḷā, saññā kukkuḷā, saṅkhārā kukkuḷā, viññāṇaṃ kukkuḷaṃ. evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmim'pi nibbindati, vedanāya'pi nibbindati, saññāya'pi nibbindati, saṅkhāresu'pi nibbindati, viññāṇasmim'pi nibbindati.

22150.meaning1: name of a hell; (comm) the heat of household life
22150.commentary: (SNa) kukkuḷā'ti ghar'āvāso kira uṇh'aṭṭhena kukkuḷā nāma hoti.

examples.text: kukkuḷā ubbhato tāta, kukkuḷaṃ patitum'icchasi, narakā ubbhato tāta, narakaṃ patitum'icchasi.

22153.meaning2: Chapter 14 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dakkho goghātako vā goghātak'antevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya, evam'eva kho adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
so santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena so yena yen'eva pakkamati samādāy'eva pakkamati

tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, mātā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharati mahatā saṃsayena garubhāraṃ. tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, mātā navannaṃ vā dasannaṃ vā māsānaṃ accayena vijāyati mahatā saṃsayena garubhāraṃ.
manussaviggaho nāma yaṃ mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, yāva maraṇakālā etth'antare eso manussaviggaho nāma.
āma, bhante, khādantī'ti. kiṃ pana tāni tāsaṃ kucchiyaṃ koṭṭh'abbhantaragatāni vilayaṃ gacchantī'ti? āma, bhante, vilayaṃ gacchantī'ti.

22161.meaning1: with a stomach; having a belly

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena māro pāpimā āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa kucchigato hoti koṭṭham'anupaviṭṭho. atha kho āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa etadahosi, kiṃ nu kho me kucchi garugaro viya mās'ācitaṃ maññe'ti.

22163.meaning1: in the belly; in the womb

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho me ayyā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yo me ayaṃ, bhante, kucchigato kumārako vā kumārikā vā so bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati dhammañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca. upāsakaṃ taṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajja't'agge pāṇ'upetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'ti.
ku'icc'etassa kad hoti sare pare. kucchitaṃ annaṃ kadannaṃ, kucchitaṃ asanaṃ kadassanaṃ.

kāraggahaṇaṃ kim'atthaṃ? ākār'anta ikār'antā ca honti, paccakkhā dhammā yassa so'yan'ti paccakkhadhammā, surabhino gandho surabhigandhi, sundaro gandho sugandhi, pūtino gandho pūtigandhi, kucchito gandho kugandhi, duṭṭhu gandho yassa so'yan'ti dugandhi, pūti eva gandho pūtigandhi.

22167.meaning2: burning sensation in the stomach; stomach inflammation

examples.text: tattha te desā tāni vatthūnī'ti mātukucchiṃ sandhāya vadati. ayam'etth'ādhippāyo, yattha te vasitaṃ, na te khattiyadhīt'ādīnaṃ kucchidesā. yattha v'āsi patiṭṭhito, na tāni khattiyadhīt'ādīnaṃ kucchivatthūni.

22169.meaning1: for the purpose of taking care of the stomach

22170.meaning1: for looking after the stomach; for taking care of the belly

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yen'eva ḍeti sapattabhāro'va ḍeti, evam'eva kho ahaṃ, āvuso, santuṭṭho ahosiṃ kāyaparihārikena cīvarena, kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena.
ekam'idaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghosit'ārāme. atha kho me ayyā kucchimatī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

22173.meaning1: disease of the stomach; stomach pain

examples.text: iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkhurogo sotarogo ghānarogo jivhārogo kāyarogo sīsarogo kaṇṇarogo mukharogo dantarogo oṭṭharogo kāso sāso pināso ḍāho jaro kucchirogo mucchā

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, uddhaṅ'gamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭh'āsayā vātā, aṅgam'aṅg'ānusārino vātā, assāso passāso… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā vāyodhātu.

ayam'etth'ādhippāyo, yattha te vasitaṃ, na te khattiyadhīt'ādīnaṃ kucchidesā. yattha v'āsi patiṭṭhito, na tāni khattiyadhīt'ādīnaṃ kucchivatthūni. atha kho dāsikucchiyaṃ tvaṃ vasi c'eva patiṭṭhito cā'ti.

22178.meaning1: for the sake of one's stomach; for the belly

examples.text: varaṃ te, bhikkhu, tiṇhena govikantanena kucchi parikanto, na tv'eva varaṃ yaṃ ratt'andhakāratimisāyaṃ kucchihetu piṇḍāya carasī'ti.

22179.sanskrit: kuja, vṛkṣa, aga, pādapa, taru, śākhin, vanaspati, druma, mahīruha

22182.meaning1: is angry; gets angry; is enraged (with)

examples.text: saccaṃ bhaṇe na kujjheyya, dajjā appam'pi yācito, etehi tīhi ṭhānehi, gacche devāna santike.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pāsāṇe lekhā na khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati. so ca khv'assa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.

22184.meaning2: having the characteristic feature of anger; with the salient feature of irritation

examples.text: mā vo kodho ajjhabhavi, mā ca kujjhittha kujjhataṃ, akkodho avihiṃsā ca, ariyesu ca paṭipadā, atha pāpajanaṃ kodho, pabbato'v'ābhimaddatī'ti.

22188.meaning1: was angry; was upset (with); was mad (at)
22188.commentary: (THIa) mā me kujjhī'ti keḷikaraṇamattena mā mayhaṃ kujjhi.

examples.text: kiṃ nu kujjhasi mā kujjhi, akkodho tissa te varaṃ
mā me kujjhi mahāvīra, mā me kujjhi mahāmuni, na hi kodhaparetassa, suddhi atthi kuto tapo.

imasmiṃ kira jātake bodhisatto koṇḍadamako ahosi. so ten'eva paratantiyuttabhāvena jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇi. devatā kujjhitvā sakalam'eva majjharaṭṭhaṃ uṇhaṃ kukkuḷavassaṃ vassāpetvā raṭṭhaṃ araṭṭham'akaṃsu.
nāgo kujjhitvā konām'āyaṃ muṇḍako mayhaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā nisinno'ti dhūpāyi, thero uttaritaraṃ dhūpāyi. nāgo, pajjali, thero'pi uttaritaraṃ pajjalitvā tassa tejaṃ pariyādiyi.
avāpuraṇaṃ ādāyā'ti kuñcikaṃ gahetvā.
varam'assatarā dantā, ājānīyā ca sindhavā, kuñjarā ca mahānāgā, attadanto tato varaṃ.
seyyathā'pi nāma kuñjaro saṭṭhihāyano gambhīraṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā sāṇadhovikaṃ nāma kīḷitajātaṃ kīḷati, evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ sāṇadhovikaṃ maññe kīḷitajātaṃ kīḷissāmi.

22198.meaning1: disturbed by male and female elephants rutting
22198.commentary: (THIa) kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitan'ti mattakuñjarehi hatthinīhi ca migānaṃ cittatāpanena rukkhagacch'ādīnaṃ sākhābhañjanena ca āloḷitapadesaṃ.

examples.text: vāḷamigasaṅghasevitaṃ, kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitaṃ, asahāyikā gantum'icchasi, rahitaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ mahāvanaṃ.
